item.tib: yi dam kun 'dus kyi rol mo 'phrul chen gar gyi rnam rol
item.coloph: 'dir yi dam kun 'dus kyi rol mo 'phrul chen gar gyi lag len 'di nyid sa yos hor zla gnyis pa'i dam can 'du phyogs dga' ba gsum par mda' chen dkar mo ri khrod du skyang nam mkha' rgyal mtshan ming gis sbyar ba'i yon tan gyis g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa rin po che nam mkha'i 'brug ltar grags par gyur cig/
